name: berth-plugin-backup
description: Snapshots of the agent's data with restic, sent anywhere rclone reaches.

features.label: Backups
features.description: Nightly encrypted snapshots of the agent's home and workspaces with restic, stored through rclone. Set the repository as `devbox_backup_repository` in the profile's ansible_vars, for example `rclone:b2:my-bucket/laptop`, and send two file secrets to the host: the repository password as `~/.config/berth-backup/password` and the rclone configuration as `~/.config/rclone/rclone.conf`.
features.summary: Nightly snapshots of your home and `/srv/agent` with restic. Caches, `node_modules` and Unity's `Library` are left out.

actions.name: snapshot
actions.label: Back up now
actions.help: Take a snapshot now and apply the retention policy. The first run creates the repository.

actions.name: list
actions.label: List snapshots
actions.help: The snapshots in the repository, of this host and of others that share it.

actions.name: restore
actions.label: Restore a snapshot
actions.help: Put the files of a snapshot back where they were taken from, on this host or on a freshly set-up one that was given the same repository and secrets. Files that are not in the snapshot stay as they are.
actions.confirm: Restore the snapshot over the files of this host?

actions.name: last-snapshot
actions.label: Last snapshot
actions.help: When the last snapshot was taken and when the next one is due. Part of Status.
